name: Choco Cake Sliced
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), SUGAR, EGGS, BAKERY SHORTENING, WATER, EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL (REFINED PALM OIL), HUMECTANTS (INS 422, INS 420), LIQUID GLUCOSE, COCOA SOLIDS (2%), INVERT SYRUP, MIXED FRUIT JAM, MILK SOLIDS, NATURAL FOOD COLOUR (INS 150d), CAKE GEL (INS 470a, INS 471, INS 475, INS 422, INS 420, INS 525), RAISING AGENT [INS 500(ii)] & BAKING POWDER], EDIBLE COMMON SALT, PRESERVATIVE (INS 282, INS 200), ACIDITY REGULATOR (INS 262, INS 260), PERMITTED NATURAL & NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOUR(S) (CHOCOLATE AND VANILLA), STABILIZER INS 412, INS 415) AND EMULSIFIERS (INS 471, INS 477, INS 322). (Numbers in brackets as per International Numbering System). CONTAINS WHEAT, MILK, EGG AND SOY INGREDIENTS.
